												MPPSC Food Safety Officer Recruitment 2025 – Apply for 120 Posts

												Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) has officially released the Food Safety Officer (FSO) Recruitment 2025 notification for 120 vacancies. This is a golden opportunity for candidates seeking a government job in the food safety sector. Eligible applicants can apply online from March 28, 2025, to April 27, 2025, through the official MPPSC website.

												

												MPPSC FSO 2025: Important Dates

												Application Start Date: March 28, 2025

												Last Date to Apply: April 27, 2025

												Fee Payment Deadline: April 27, 2025

												Correction Window: April 29, 2025

												Admit Card & Exam Date: To be announced

												

												Application Fee

												General & Other State Candidates: ₹540/-

												MP Reserved Category: ₹290/-

												Portal Charges: ₹40/- (Included)

												Correction Fee: ₹50/- (Extra)

												Payment Mode: Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking

												

												Eligibility Criteria

												Candidates must hold a Graduate/Postgraduate/Doctorate degree in Food Technology, Dairy Technology, Biotechnology, Oil Technology, Agricultural Science, Veterinary Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, or Medicine from a recognized university. The qualification should be approved by the Food Authority of India as per the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

												

												Age Limit (as of 01-01-2025)

												Minimum Age: 21 years

												Maximum Age: 40 years

												Age relaxation as per MPPSC norms.

												

												Why Apply for MPPSC FSO 2025?

												This recruitment offers job security, an attractive salary package, and career growth opportunities in the government sector. If you meet the eligibility criteria, don’t miss out—apply online before the deadline!

												For detailed information, read the official notification on the MPPSC website.
